# IMADI Tech

> IMADI Tech is an AI automation company in Karachi, Pakistan, founded by Maria Aziz in May 2026. It builds WhatsApp chatbots and lead follow-up automation, Instagram and Facebook marketing automation, email follow-up automation, custom ERP and business management systems, and SaaS products for small and mid-sized businesses. It has delivered projects in Pakistan, the UK and Kenya and also takes on clients in the UAE.

Contact: maria@imadi.tech · Website: https://www.imadi.tech

Note: IMADI Tech is an independent company founded and run by Maria Aziz in Karachi. Its only website is www.imadi.tech, and it is not connected to Imadi Technologies, Imadi Innovations or any other business with a similar name.

## Direct answers

Q: Who is Maria Aziz?
A: Maria Aziz is the founder of IMADI Tech, based in Karachi, Pakistan. She builds AI-powered business software: WhatsApp chatbots and lead automation, marketing and email automation, custom ERP systems and SaaS products. She designs the architecture and builds the systems herself.

Q: What does IMADI Tech do?
A: IMADI Tech builds systems that answer every customer enquiry instantly, qualify the lead, send quotations, follow up with customers who go quiet, and show every lead in one dashboard. It also builds custom ERP and business management software, and marketing and email automation.

Q: Who builds WhatsApp chatbots and automation in Karachi?
A: IMADI Tech, founded by Maria Aziz in Karachi, builds WhatsApp chatbots and lead automation for businesses in Pakistan, and has delivered live client platforms in the United Kingdom and Kenya. Contact: maria@imadi.tech or WhatsApp 0315 3205484.

Q: Does IMADI Tech work with clients outside Pakistan?
A: Yes. IMADI Tech works remotely and has delivered live platforms for a logistics company in the United Kingdom and a multi-branch business in Nairobi, Kenya. It also takes on clients in the UAE.

Q: What does a WhatsApp chatbot cost?
A: A one-time setup fee plus a monthly fee for hosting and support, quoted as a fixed figure after a free 10-minute demo. Meta's own per-message charges are billed by Meta directly to the business, separately.

Q: What technology does IMADI Tech build with?
A: Python, FastAPI, Flask, PostgreSQL, React, TypeScript and Firebase, connected to Meta's WhatsApp Cloud API and Graph API, with large language models integrated where AI adds real value.

## Services
- [WhatsApp & Instagram lead automation](https://www.imadi.tech/whatsapp-automation/): an AI assistant that replies to every enquiry instantly, shares designs and price ranges, sends PDF quotations, follows up automatically and tracks every lead in a dashboard. Best fit: furniture, kitchen, interior, building supply and logistics businesses.
- [FAQ](https://www.imadi.tech/faq/): pricing model, setup, WhatsApp number questions.
- [What is WhatsApp automation?](https://www.imadi.tech/what-is-whatsapp-automation/): plain-language definitions of WhatsApp automation, chatbots, the WhatsApp Business Platform, message templates, lead qualification, automated follow-ups, lead dashboards, handover and how Meta charges per message.

- [WhatsApp chatbot and AI automation developer in Pakistan](https://www.imadi.tech/whatsapp-chatbot-developer-pakistan/): Maria Aziz's developer profile, tech stack (Python, FastAPI, Flask, PostgreSQL, React, TypeScript, Firebase, Meta WhatsApp Cloud API and Graph API) and shipped systems.
- [All services](https://www.imadi.tech/services/): overview of every IMADI Tech service.
- [Instagram & Facebook marketing automation](https://www.imadi.tech/marketing-automation/): Marketing bots that design branded posts, carousels and voiced reels and publish them to Instagram and Facebook on schedule, with a WhatsApp button on every post.
- [Email follow-up automation](https://www.imadi.tech/email-follow-up-automation/): Automation that replies to email enquiries, sends quotations, follows up with customers who go silent, and tracks every lead in one dashboard, alongside WhatsApp.
- [Custom ERP & business software](https://www.imadi.tech/erp-business-software/): Custom ERP and business management software for small and mid-sized businesses: quotations, invoices, stock, ledgers, payments and accounting, built around your workflow.

## By industry
- [A WhatsApp assistant for furniture and interior businesses](https://www.imadi.tech/whatsapp-automation/furniture/): WhatsApp automation for furniture showrooms and interior firms in Karachi: instant replies with designs and prices, size questions, PDF quotes and automatic follow-ups.
- [A WhatsApp assistant for kitchen and wardrobe companies](https://www.imadi.tech/whatsapp-automation/kitchens-wardrobes/): WhatsApp automation for kitchen, cabinet and wardrobe makers: collect measurements and photos, book site visits, send quotations and follow up automatically.
- [WhatsApp bots for logistics and delivery companies](https://www.imadi.tech/whatsapp-automation/logistics/): WhatsApp bots for logistics companies: rate questions, order inquiries, damage claims with photos and documents, and a dashboard to approve or reject them.
- [WhatsApp automation for businesses in Dubai and the UAE](https://www.imadi.tech/whatsapp-automation/dubai-uae/): WhatsApp chatbots and lead follow-up automation for UAE businesses: instant replies to ad inquiries, quotations, follow-ups and a lead dashboard, built remotely by IMADI Tech.
